feature_policy: Exact 58 Phase1 eligible columns, identical order to Phase2; no additions/selection. Historical signed input names and event side are causal covariates, never directional outputs. No UT feature input.

A.preprocessor: TRAIN median imputation with indicators, keep_empty_features=True; TRAIN StandardScaler; TRAIN categorical constant MISSING and dense onehot unknown-ignore

B.calibration: separate strictly earlier sigmoid via FrozenEstimator; >=1000 rows and >=100 per class; otherwise unavailable, no fallback promotion

C.target_formula: At exact completed5m event q with current frozen SECONDARY_REFERENCE UT state d(q) nonzero/finite: 1 iff at least one raw crossing signal(q+k*5m) == -d(q), k=1..6; 0 otherwise. All six subsequent completed5m timestamps and signals must exist; otherwise null. Settings sensitivity1, WilderATR10, ordinary OHLC, gap reset and first100 completed5m bars masked. No tuning.
C.target_scope: 30m reference-sensor reversal risk conditional on BOS/SWEEP events, not general chop, not primary UT and not trading outcomes
C.target_source: Phase2B evaluate.py raw_outcomes + exact-q event mapping; hash-verified whipsaw_labels.parquet
C.predictor_policy: 58 unchanged causal base features only; no UT direction/stop/signal/age inputs

D.activity_uncertainty: Calibration residual mean absolute error, residual std and q90 absolute residual conditional on TRAIN PRE60 decile; global earlier-cal fallback for empty cells. Prediction dispersion = conditional residual std, not an ensemble epistemic estimate.
D.ood_score: TRAIN q01-q99 support tails: mean outside fraction plus bounded max excess/range plus unseen categorical share, divided by3
D.drift_score: mean numeric PSI/(1+PSI) using only events from prior14 completed UTC days, updated at each UTC day start; TRAIN bin references. No contemporaneous/future day rows.
D.cross_head_disagreement: 0.5*(abs(train_ecdf_activity-pB)+abs(pB-pC)); cross-target incompatibility proxy only because horizons/targets differ
D.confidence_score: equal mean(activity_confidence,B_confidence,C_confidence,1-feature_missing_fraction,1-ood_score,1-cross_head_proxy,1-drift_score), multiplied by indicator(no critical feature missing). Components/unavailable scores preserved; no outcome optimization.
D.ABSTAIN: interface only; critical-missing integrity flag, no selected live policy

success: Retain predictive head only if primary loss improves vs all three baselines in 3/3 chronological folds, classification Brier improves too, no severe calibration failure. Family/symbol/sensitivity evaluated descriptively; no claim of external validation. D separation needs consistent row-matched baseline-relative skill improvement at fixed coverage across heads; otherwise interface only.

calibration_sanity_for_retention.purpose: predeclared broad research sanity assessment; not trading thresholds or optimized model parameters

evaluation: Same Phase2 fold windows/105 symbols; label_end_ms<role_end; TRAIN/CAL knownAt<role_end-240m; null labels excluded per head. No new split or all-history fit.
